why: A May 2026 arXiv paper by Colliot-Thélène and Schreieder, 'Divisibility phenomena in motivic Bloch–Ogus theory,' proves l-divisibility (up to torsion) results for motivic cohomology of smooth projective varieties over finite fields and discusses this 'in relation to' Parshin's conjecture, but search summaries don't make clear whether it proves a new case/bound of the K-theory vanishing statement itself or is adjacent motivic-cohomology work; a 2020 arXiv preprint claiming a full proof (2011.05544) predates the snapshot and its status (published/withdrawn) is unclear from search alone.
